# GLpatches®

> GLpatches® is an informational and educational website covering blood sugar wellness, appetite support, metabolic wellness, ingredients, daily patch use, references, and related healthy lifestyle topics.

## About GLpatches

GLpatches® is presented as a daily transdermal dietary supplement patch for adults interested in appetite support, healthy blood sugar already within the normal range, and everyday metabolic wellness.

GLpatches® is not a GLP-1 medication and does not contain semaglutide, tirzepatide, or another GLP-1 receptor agonist. It is not intended to replace prescription weight-loss or diabetes medication.

## Key Topics

- Blood sugar support
- Healthy blood sugar already within the normal range
- Appetite support
- Metabolic wellness
- Glucose metabolism
- Daily wellness routines
- Transdermal supplement use
- Ingredient information
- Healthy lifestyle information
- Frequently asked questions
- Scientific references and educational resources

## Ingredients

GLpatches® contains seven named ingredients:

- Berberine Extract
- Garcinia Cambogia
- Green Tea Extract
- Cinnamon Extract
- B-Complex Vitamins
- Chromium & Potassium
- L-Glutamine

Research discussed on the website primarily concerns individual ingredients, and much of the available research involves oral forms. The finished GLpatches® transdermal patch has not been established through its own clinical trial.

## How to Use

GLpatches® is designed for once-daily use. Apply one patch to clean, dry skin and follow the recommended directions. The patch is designed to deliver its ingredient blend transdermally over approximately 8–12 hours. Application areas may include the stomach or arm, with rotation of application sites recommended to help reduce the chance of skin irritation.

## Manufacturing

GLpatches® is made in the USA in a GMP-certified, FDA-registered facility. FDA registration applies to the manufacturing facility and does not mean that GLpatches® itself is FDA-approved.

## Website Information

The GLpatches® website provides general educational information about blood sugar wellness, appetite support, metabolic wellness, ingredients, supplement use, lifestyle habits, and related health topics.

Website content is intended for general educational purposes and is not medical advice. Information presented on the website should not be used to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

## Important Disclosures

GLpatches® is a dietary supplement and not a prescription medication. It is not a GLP-1 drug or substitute for prescription diabetes or weight-loss medication.

Individual experiences and results may vary. Visitors who are pregnant or nursing, have a medical condition, take prescription medications, or are managing diabetes or weight under medical supervision should consult a qualified healthcare professional before use.
